title: eUSB2 repeater: eD+ / eD- retimed onto USB2 dp / dm, control packets (PID C3, NRZI, bit stuffing, CRC8) writing and reading an 8 x 8 register file with read responses sent on dp / dm, and squelch detection on long SE0

fields.desc: signal loss: SE0 longer than the squelch threshold (cleared by J); same as the squelch pin

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: SE1 on the line, bit-stuff error, truncated or over-long control packet, or CRC8 mismatch. Sticky in the core until PRESETN, so the bit is set again on every clock

notes: edp / edm (eUSB2 line in, one bit cell per PCLK), dp / dm (retimed USB2 line out) and squelch pass through unchanged.
The 8 x 8 register file (squelch threshold, termination, scratch) is reached through control packets on the line only.
